NOTE (added Sept 2026): a second NaPi2b agent, upifitamab rilsodotin, was independently discontinued for efficacy (UPLIFT trial missed its pre-specified response-rate threshold, 15.6%% ORR) after an earlier FDA partial clinical hold for 5 grade-5 bleeding events (4 treatment-related) in ~560 patients. The bleeding mechanism was never publicly resolved as on-target NaPi2b toxicity, payload toxicity, or otherwise -- every source found states the cause was "under evaluation" and the story moves on to the efficacy result without returning to it. Kept as efficacy_fail, not relabeled toxic, because the program's own stated ending was efficacy and the toxicity mechanism was never confirmed on-target -- but flagged here so this label is not read as a clean safety record.

FDA BLA voluntarily withdrawn 2026 after the confirmatory phase 3 HERTHENA-Lung02 trial (EGFR-mutated NSCLC) missed its overall-survival endpoint despite an earlier positive PFS signal; Daiichi Sankyo/Merck attributed the withdrawal to the OS miss, not a safety finding. Two ILD-related deaths occurred in the treatment arm but were not cited as the reason for withdrawal -- a clean efficacy failure by the sponsors' own account, same pattern as GPNMB.
